name: Atmos Rewards Ascent Visa Signature Card
issuer: Atmos Financial / Bank of Missouri (issued in partnership with Alaska Airlines Miles program)

tripDelay.notes: Trip delay insurance details not publicly confirmed for this card. Visa Signature benefits may include travel assistance services.

tripCancellation.notes: Trip cancellation coverage details not publicly confirmed. Standard Visa Signature travel protections may apply.

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: Travel accident insurance details not publicly confirmed. Visa Signature may include basic coverage.

emergencyMedical.notes: Travel and Emergency Assistance Services via Visa Signature (referral-based, does not cover costs).

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver via Visa Signature — secondary coverage. Decline the rental company's CDW.

otherCredits.name: Annual Fee Waiver — First Year
otherCredits.notes: Annual fee of $95 is waived for the first year.

otherCredits.name: Atmos Climate Credit
otherCredits.notes: Card is positioned as a climate-forward card (Atmos is a climate fintech). May offer carbon offset credits or sustainability credits — details subject to program terms.

rewards.baseRate: 1x Alaska Airlines miles per $1 on all purchases
rewards.travelRate: 3x Alaska Airlines miles on Alaska Airlines purchases
otherBonusCategories: 3x on Alaska Airlines tickets and partner flights

pointValue.transferPartners: Alaska Airlines Mileage Plan miles — transfer to Oneworld and non-alliance partners. Alaska miles valued at ~1.2-1.8 cents each toward flights.

emergencyContacts.general: Contact Atmos Financial customer service or back of card
emergencyContacts.international: Contact back of card for international number

travelPerks: Earn Alaska Airlines Mileage Plan miles on all purchases
2x miles on dining, gas, and groceries
Visa Signature travel protections and benefits
bestFor: Alaska Airlines loyalists who want to earn Mileage Plan miles on everyday spending with no foreign transaction fees
